<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even lower daat is true, but it must be connected to upper daat to reveal its infinite source.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is that also lower daat is truth, and nevertheless the connection of lower daat with upper daat is necessary</t>
    <t s="3">(see above section 4),</t>
    <t s="4">for the matter of the truth of lower daat is because its content</t>
    <t s="5">(in inwardness)</t>
    <t s="6">is the revelation of above, without end,</t>
    <t s="7">and this matter is revealed through its connection with upper daat.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="22">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The perfection of nature's governance is achieved when the revelation of above-nature is drawn into it.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And likewise regarding the governance of nature,</t>
    <t s="1">that although the governance of nature is also that "You are He who brought forth the ten tikkunim... to govern the worlds through them,"</t>
    <t s="2">nevertheless, the perfection of the governance of nature is when the revelation of above-nature is drawn into it,</t>
    <t s="3">for specifically through this it is revealed that the matter of "to govern the worlds through them" has its root in the aspect of "You."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="23">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The connection of lower and upper daat, and nature with above-nature, is achieved through the revelation of the Essence above both, enabling the drawing of Atzmus into the world.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">B)</t>
    <t s="2">And now, this that was explained above</t>
    <t s="3">(section 10)</t>
    <t s="4">that when it is felt in the two intellects</t>
    <t s="5">(of upper daat and lower daat)</t>
    <t s="6">that their content is to reveal the matters that are in Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="7">(which is above without end and below without limit)</t>
    <t s="8">the two intellects are one matter,</t>
    <t s="9">is in generality.</t>
    <t s="10">But in particularity,</t>
    <t s="11">even the matters of above without end and below without limit</t>
    <t s="12">(as they are in Ein Sof46)</t>
    <t s="13">are two matters.</t>
    <t s="14">And based on this,</t>
    <t s="15">in order for there to be the connection of lower daat with upper daat,</t>
    <t s="16">and likewise the connection of nature with above-nature,</t>
    <t s="17">it is through the revelation of the Essence that is above both of them.</t>
    <t s="18">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="19">that this is what is stated in the maamar47</t>
    <t s="20">that the drawing of the revelation of above-nature into nature is through the drawing from the aspect of "You are One,"</t>
    <t s="21">even though the revelation of above-nature is also through the drawing of the aspect of "You is supreme,"</t>
    <t s="22">for the matter of above-nature that comes from the side of "You is supreme,"</t>
    <t s="23">above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="24">is not drawn into nature</t>
    <t s="25">(the chain of descent),</t>
    <t s="26">and the drawing of the revelation of above-nature into nature is through the drawing of the aspect of "You is One."</t>
    <t s="27">And this is also the reason for the necessity of the connection of the two matters of nature and above-nature,</t>
    <t s="28">for each of the two matters has its root in the light of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="29">and through the connection of the two matters is the drawing of the Awtsmoos.</t>
    <t s="30">That is,</t>
    <t s="31">that through this there is the possibility</t>
    <t s="32">(even from the side of the world)</t>
    <t s="33">that through avodah there will be in the world the drawing of the revelation of the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="34">and through this the intention of the creation of the world</t>
    <t s="35">(nature)</t>
    <t s="36">is completed, that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling place in the lower realms48.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
